title: isodon grosseserratus
intro: Isodon grosseserratus, commonly known as Dragon's Blood Herb or Huang Qi, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Isodon grosseserratus include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, which contributes to its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Isodon grosseserratus include iridoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
